name: t13-read-v9
idea_origin: DeepSeek line, 28 Oct: bench of t13-read-v4 on bank items of L1 review-close months (q-loss ~4.4 points per decision, ten times a common story) and the notes of costly real choices (half reject the best option as a private or later fix)
operator: one idea: the quiet path before a review
hypothesis: Before an L1 review the costly picks are polite options with a hidden Network or Output cost (turning a colleague down, correcting in public, putting own work next to a colleague), chosen because the risk list marks the quiet alternative (a private word, a written follow-up) as burying the problem, although in the catalogue 40-45% of private or later options carry no risk. Naming the social costs and saying that a private word or written follow-up to the people concerned is not burying a problem should cut those picks without more risky choices.
predicted_behaviour: Lower q-loss and fewer Network/Output-losing picks than t13-read-v4 on bank items of L1 review-close months; no more risky picks on the control items.
refutation: Same q-loss on the L1 review-close items, or more risky picks or q-loss on the control items.
